title: Earn a standing rule (costly tier)
description: A question type of the costly tier earns a standing rule when the Wilson lower bound over the founder's full answer history reaches the line. The founder approves each rule.

question.text: Has this question type earned a standing answer?

evidence.sensor: the Wilson lower bound at z 1.96 over the founder's answer history (operating-rules.json questions.standing)

sources.note: The founder's answers to the question type

scale.meaning: The Wilson lower bound on the founder's agreement rate, 0 to 1

note: The same number as questions.standing.costly in packages/naive/src/terms/operating-rules.json; the bar is proved in packages/naive/lean/Naive/StandingRules.lean.
